name: genpark-enterprise-compliance-pii-redaction-sentinel-skill
description: Enterprise Regulatory Compliance & Multi-Pattern PII Redaction Sentinel (inspired by Tencent Cloud Data Governance & GDPR/HIPAA Enterprise Policies). Detects and sanitizes personally identifiable information, financial account numbers, JWT tokens, and cryptographic keys using deterministic zero-leakage masking.

tools.name: redact_enterprise_compliance_data
tools.description: Enterprise compliance sanitization: scan text for PII/secrets, redact credit cards, social security numbers, API tokens, and generate audit compliance certificates.

text_content.description: Raw enterprise text, log stream, or document content to scan.

strict_mode.description: If true, also masks high-entropy candidate secrets.
